summary: First E2E iteration of CVLN Academy OS. Comprehensive backend pytest suite (20 tests) and end-to-end Playwright frontend test — all green. Backend: health metadata, register/duplicate/login/me, formations list (30) + FMS-01 detail (12 modules), quiz no-leak + all-correct submit awards CC + signal + threshold badges, missions list/accept/submit with CC accrual, badges (8) + mine, progression summary, FREK profile, mentor agents + Claude Sonnet 4.6 chat (real LLM reply persisted). Frontend: registration → FREK-005 badge, sidebar (6 nav items + lang FR/EN/KR + logout), dashboard KPI cards + stade timeline + missions preview + FREK activity, Formations catalog → FMS-01 detail with 12 module cards, Quiz modal all-correct submission returned '100% (8/8) · +6 CC · signal FREK-WORK', Missions/Badges/FREK Profile pages load, Mentor floating panel opens + LLM reply received, logout returns to landing.
critical_code_review_comments: quiz.py hard-codes correct answers to fixed choice IDs (Q1=A, Q3=VRAI, Q4=C, Q6=C). If E1 later randomizes choice order, evaluator must be re-derived from correct=True flags server-side — evaluate() already does this correctly; only the quiz builder ordering assumption matters if reshuffling is introduced.
routes.py _award_threshold_badges runs on every quiz pass + mission submit — O(n badges) per call, fine for 8 badges but consider indexing user_badges by (user_id, badge_code) as scale grows.
frek_profile stade band computation duplicates thresholds from services/frek_core.STADE_THRESHOLDS — DRY: source from one place to avoid drift.
MentorPanel does not require auth guard — the mentor button is rendered inside Layout which is behind auth, but if reused elsewhere the /api/mentor/chat 401 error would only surface via toast.
test_credentials: Auto-generated qa+cvln-<uuid>@test.com / Cvln!2026 per session (fresh account each run per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Sample created during this run: FREK-005.
seed_data_creation: None (backend startup seed populates 30 formations, 8 badges, 8 missions, poles). Test users are created via /api/auth/register.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seed is idempotent — safe to rerun. Quiz correct answers are Q1=A, Q2=A, Q3=VRAI, Q4=C, Q5=A, Q6=C, Q7=A, Q8=A per quiz.py. Mentor uses real Emergent LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.6) — allow up to 60s. FREK-ID counter is sequential across the whole DB, so numbers grow monotonically across runs.
